articles.body:
Hi,

The confirmation mail our applicants receive says the decision will be communicated "by 15 November 2025". The date is written into the template text rather than pulled from the round.

Can it be made dynamic? Otherwise we will forget it again next year.

Best,
Nina Dahl
articles.subject: Applicant mail templates still show last year's deadline

articles.body:
Hi Nina,

It can. There is a placeholder for the round's decision date; I have corrected your confirmation template to use it and sent a test to your address.

Your three other templates have the same hard-coded date. I would like to go through them with you on a short call rather than guess which field each should use.

Best,
Mia
